Program overview
This course has an approach based on solid scientific knowledge that can support real practice with patients, allowing you to take evidence-based decisions with your patients.
It has the endorsement of the International Society for Electroporation-Based Technologies and Treatments (ISEBTT).
This course is based on the experience gathered after teaching more than 270 veterinarians how to correctly perform electrochemotherapy. This has allowed us to select the content especially for clinical veterinarians or surgeons who specialize in veterinary oncology of small and large animals.
It is organized and directed by Drs. Guillermo Marshall, Matías Tellado and Felipe Maglietti.
Online Veterinary Electrochemotherapy Course
Practical approach
This course follows an updated, practice-oriented design and continues to offer a complete online training experience in veterinary electrochemotherapy.
We are grateful to have shared knowledge and professional experience with more than 200 colleagues, which has helped shape this 2026 edition.
The course is approved for CME credits, and the program is endorsed by the International Society for Electroporation-Based Technologies and Treatments (ISEBTT).

4. Evaluation and certificate

Goals
That the participants:
Acquire the knowledge and skills needed to correctly indicate and perform electrochemotherapy in the veterinary setting.
Acquire the basic knowledge of electricity needed to understand how an effective electric field is formed to electroporate tissues, including the physical-chemical foundations that support the technique.
Learn the main highlights of the presentation, epidemiology, carcinogenesis, diagnosis, biological behavior and treatment of neoplasms frequently treated with electrochemotherapy in veterinary medicine.
Exercise and study notable scientific articles, book chapters and notes related to electrochemotherapy in order to acquire independence in your professional education in the field.
Evaluate the relevance and methodology of scientific articles in the field.
Enroll now
Methodology and pedagogical strategy
Course organization
The development of the course consists of 6 modules that are presented every two weeks. It is recommended to spend 25 hours with each module including theoretical classes, practical activities, and reading the additional information.
Each Module contains:
4-5 recorded classes (updated theoretical content of the main topics)
Practical material (treatment videos and practical activities)
6x 1.5-Hour Live Classroom (interactive virtual meeting with live treatments, consultations, questions and sharing)
Additional information (scientific articles, summaries, technical videos, tables, and selected texts)
The complete course load is 100 hours.
The complete course load is 100 hours.
Course program
COURSE SCHEDULE | Argentina local time (GMT-3)
Welcome Class
, Monday November 2nd – Welcome Session (synchronous) – 3 to 4 pm (GMT -3, Buenos Aires Time Zone)
* I
f the minimum enrollment is not reached, the course will be offered in a personalized focus-group format that includes all the program’s theoretical material and only two live Zoom meetings with the instructors for personalized learning.
Module 1: Fundamentals
Friday, August 21th – Practical Session – Module 1 (synchronous) – 3 pm (GMT -3, Buenos Aires Time Zone)
Class 1:
Fundamentals and concept of the electric field
Class 2:
Effects of electric pulses on tissues
Class 3:
Equipment and electrodes available on the market
Class 4:
Pharmacology of the most commonly used drugs
Class 5:
Oncoimmunology applied to electroporation
Module 2: Procedure and management in cats
Friday, August 28th – Practical Session – Module 2 (synchronous) – 3 pm (GMT -3, Buenos Aires Time Zone)
Class 1:
Fundamentals of the procedure in cats
Class 2:
Pre- and post-treatment management. Link with other therapies
Class 3:
Limitations and common mistakes of the technique in cats
Class 4:
Indication of ECT within the framework of oncologic therapy
Module 3: Uses in cats
Friday, September 4th – Practical Session – Module 2 (synchronous) – 3 pm (GMT -3, Buenos Aires Time Zone)
Class 1:
ECT for neoplasms of the oral cavity
Class 2:
ECT for injection-site-associated sarcoma (ISAS) / vaccine-associated sarcoma
Class 3:
ECT for squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) and other skin diseases
Class 4:
ECT and cryosurgery — comparative or combined approach
Module 4: Procedure ands management in dogs
Friday, September 11th – Practical Session – Module 4 (synchronous) – 3 pm (GMT -3, Buenos Aires Time Zone)
Class 1:
Fundamentals of the procedure in dogs
Class 2:
Pre- and post-treatment management and link with other therapies
Class 3:
Limitations and common mistakes of the technique
Class 4:
Unconventional applications of ECT
Module 5: Uses in Dogs
Friday, September 18th – Practical Session – Module 5 (synchronous) – 3 pm (GMT -3, Buenos Aires Time Zone)
Class 1:
Electrochemotherapy for oral and nasal neoplasms
Class 2:
Electrochemotherapy for soft tissue sarcomas
Class 3:
Electrochemotherapy for mast cell tumors
Class 4:
Electrochemotherapy for perianal neoplasms
Module 6: Other Uses
Friday, September 25th – Practical Session – Module 6 (synchronous) – 3 pm (GMT -3, Buenos Aires Time Zone)
Class 1:
Interpretation of articles and results in electroporation
Class 2:
Uses of electrochemotherapy in horses
Class 3:
Veterinary gene electrotransfer
Class 4:
Translational approach to ECT and GET
Friday, October 9th, 3:00–4:00 PM — Final course exam
Evaluation and certificate
Course materials and participation
During the course, participants will have digital material, books, selected scientific articles, videos of theoretical classes, treatment schemes, and extended information in English.
A WHATSAPP GROUP will be created for individual administration, in which each student can take advantage of the activities they want and collaborate with the group from different aspects.
The course is endorsed by the ISEBTT (International Society for Electroporation-Based Technologies and Treatments).
The course includes evaluation and a certificate of completion according to the program presented on this page.
